$comment: TypeScript 7 does not auto-discover node_modules/@types; this list is the
same set TypeScript 5.9 auto-discovered for this program. See the root
tsconfig.json for the full rationale and the maintenance rule.
`extends` gives this program the root's `paths`, so `@datazen/*` imports
resolve. Without it the program reported 245 errors that had nothing to do
with the code: they were 'Cannot find module @datazen/driver-sdk' and
`vite/client` supplies the ambient Vite contract (import.meta.env and the
`*.svg` / `*.svg?url` module declarations). The root program gets the same
contract from src/vite-env.d.ts, which is inside src/ and therefore not
visible to a program rooted in packages/extension-points. This program
reaches 16 app files transitively and needs the contract today.
